subject: Align calendars for product preview + security touchpoint
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example>
To: Emma Zhou <emma@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.example>
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Align calendars for product preview + security touchpoint

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost while keeping latency under 200ms for your ambulatory triage workflows.
- Main constraints: PHI-sensitive PII, on-prem model endpoints for auditability, and procurement lead-time for dedicated capacity.
- Next obvious step: short product preview (30 minutes) with our Solutions Engineer to map your flow to Redwood and surface any compliance questions.

Proposed 30-minute windows (PST) — pick one that works for your team and your security contact:
1) Tue Mar 7, 10:00–10:30
2) Wed Mar 8, 14:00–14:30
3) Thu Mar 9, 08:30–09:00

If none of these work, tell me two slots that directionally fit and we’ll adapt. Also please confirm who from your side should be present for the security/compliance portion (SOC2/PII/data flows) so we have the right folks on the call.

I’m attaching: redwood-sales-deck.pdf and a short SOC2 evidence checklist (soc2-evidence-checklist.xlsx) to help your security lead scope the ask.

Agenda (30 min):
- 5m quick recap & goals
- 15m targeted preview: routing, data controls, and deployment modes
- 10m Q&A + next steps (procurement/PO/POCs)

Thanks — look forward to locking something in.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.example
+1 (415) 555-0128

Attachments: redwood-sales-deck.pdf (12MB); soc2-evidence-checklist.xlsx (35KB)

From: Emma Zhou <emma@helixhealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example>
Cc: procurement@helixhealth.com
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Align calendars for product preview + security touchpoint

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for the clear recap and the pre-reads. Good to see the proposed agenda — fits what we discussed.

We can do option 2 (Wed Mar 8, 14:00–14:30 PST). I’m going to loop in our security lead for the meeting: Marco Diaz (marco.d@helixhealth.com). I’ve also CC’d procurement to keep them in the scheduling loop.

A couple of asks before the session:
- Can you confirm whether any sample data will be uploaded during the demo (we prefer sanitized examples)?
- Could you send a one-paragraph summary of the expected outcomes from the demo to share with Marco and procurement?

If you can get those over today we’ll lock the slot on our side.

—Emma
Emma Zhou
Head of Clinical Ops | Helix Health
emma@helixhealth.com

Date: Sat, 3 Mar 2028 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed Wed 14:00 PST — preview + compliance 

Emma / Marco / team —

Thanks for confirming — Wed Mar 8, 14:00–14:30 PST is locked on our side. I’m looping in Monica Patel (Solutions Engineer) who will run the preview and Jordan Blake who will cover procurement/contract questions if they come up.

Quick answers to Emma’s asks:
- No production data will be uploaded during the session; Monica will use sanitized examples and a small synthetic dataset to demonstrate routing and KV cache effects.
- One-paragraph expected outcomes (for sharing):
  Redwood will demonstrate a 30-min targeted preview showing how a hybrid deployment can meet sub-200ms latency for triage inference while preserving auditability. By the end of the session we’ll have:
  - a mapped customer flow to Redwood’s deployment options,
  - identified the compliance owner and immediate evidence requests (SOC2 checklist), and
  - a proposed follow-up plan (POC scope + procurement milestones).

I’ve attached a calendar invite (calendar-invite.ics) and a short link to the pre-reads: https://drive.redwood.example/preview/helix-pre-read

See you Wed — Monica will send the meeting link and a compact agenda in the morning of the 8th.

Best,
Rishi

Attachments: calendar-invite.ics

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example>

Date: Sat, 3 Mar 2028 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Confirmed Wed 14:00 PST — preview + compliance

Hi Emma / Marco —

Thanks for the intro — excited to run the short preview. Zoom link below (will send an updated calendar with join link as well):
https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=preview

Compact agenda (30m):
- 0–5m: quick intros + success criteria
- 5–20m: targeted preview — routing, KV cache, and data control options (sanitized examples only)
- 20–28m: integration and deployment questions
- 28–30m: next steps & POC scope

Questions for you before Wed:
- Who should attend from your infra/security team besides Marco?
- Any specific compliance docs Marco would like us to surface in the follow-up (SOC2 section, data retention policy, audit logs)?

Thanks — I’ll keep the demo lean and technical-focused.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
